events.title: AvalonBay, Equity Residential shareholders approve merger
events.summary: Shareholders of AvalonBay Communities Inc. (NYSE:AVB) and Equity Residential (NYSE:EQR) have approved all proposals for their merger of equals. The merger is expected to close on Monday, August 17, 2026, after which the combined company will be renamed Vivmark Residential and trade under the ticker symbol VMRK on the NYSE. This strategic move unites two major equity REITs, expanding their presence in key metropolitan areas across the U.S.

articles.headline: Equity Residential, AvalonBay shareholders approve merger (EQR:NYSE)

events.title: AvalonBay Communities (NYSE: AVB) holders approve merger and 2.793‑for‑1 share exchange
events.summary: AvalonBay Communities stockholders overwhelmingly approved the proposed merger of equals with Equity Residential, along with merger-related compensation and an adjournment proposal, at a special meeting on August 12, 2026. The merger is expected to close on August 17, 2026, with each AvalonBay share converting into 2.793 Equity Residential common shares. The combined entity will be named Vivmark Residential and will trade on the NYSE under the ticker "VMRK."

articles.headline: AvalonBay Communities (NYSE: AVB) holders approve merger and 2.793‑for‑1 share exchange

events.title: Southern Company (NYSE:SO) Moves With Grid And Rate-Sensitive Sector Themes
events.summary: Southern Company (NYSE:SO) is trading in line with the broader utility sector, influenced by rising Treasury yields and the anticipation of tomorrow's inflation data. The company is experiencing significant demand growth driven by data centers in the Southeast, particularly Georgia, necessitating substantial investment in grid modernization and nuclear generation capacity. Its diversified energy portfolio and strong regional presence position it to address these evolving market and demand dynamics.

articles.headline: Southern Company (NYSE:SO) Moves With Grid And Rate-Sensitive Sector Themes

events.title: Nucor (NYSE:NUE) in Focus as Steel Names Draw Attention Before Inflation Data
events.summary: Nucor (NYSE:NUE) is drawing attention as a prominent steel producer ahead of upcoming inflation data, with equity benchmarks near record highs. Despite thin summer trading volumes and rising Treasury yields, metals have held firm, keeping steel companies like Nucor in focus. The company, known for its diversified, scrap-based electric arc furnace steelmaking, serves various industrial sectors and its performance is closely watched as an indicator for the broader North American steel industry.

articles.headline: Nucor (NYSE:NUE) in Focus as Steel Names Draw Attention Before Inflation Data

events.title: AQR group discloses 5.96% holding in Maywood Acquisition Corp. 2 (MYX)
events.summary: AQR Capital Management, LLC, along with AQR Capital Management Holdings, LLC and AQR Arbitrage, LLC, has reported a beneficial ownership of 5.96% in Maywood Acquisition Corp. 2 (MYX). This equates to 625,099 Class A ordinary shares, over which the group exercises shared voting and dispositive power. The filing indicates a neutral sentiment and moderate impact for MYX.

articles.headline: AQR group discloses 5.96% holding in Maywood Acquisition Corp. 2 (MYX)

events.title: Perspective: Morning Commentary for August 12
events.summary: This morning commentary by Arlan Suderman focuses on July's CPI data, which largely met analyst expectations, and geopolitical events impacting markets. Key issues include a significant Ukrainian attack on Russia's Novorossiysk naval base, raising concerns about commodity exports, and China's aggressive military drills near Taiwan. The article also anticipates the highly awaited WASDE crop report, which is expected to provide updated corn and soybean yields and demand estimates.

articles.headline: Perspective: Morning Commentary for August 12

events.title: REAX: Acquisition of RE/MAX creates a global, tech-driven real estate leader with major synergy potential
events.summary: The article highlights that REAX's agent count and revenue have grown due to its tech-enabled platform and strong agent economics. The acquisition of RE/MAX is expected to form a global real estate leader, diversifying revenue streams, creating significant cost synergies, and opening up major AI-driven consumer engagement opportunities. This summary is based on The Real Brokerage, Inc.'s Oppenheimer Conference Audio Transcript from August 12, 2026.

articles.headline: REAX: Acquisition of RE/MAX creates a global, tech-driven real estate leader with major synergy potential

events.title: Vistra Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Pricing and Lotus, Revenues Miss
events.summary: Vistra (VST) reported Q2 2026 earnings of $1.80 per share, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate, which led to a 3.08% stock gain. Despite beating earnings estimates due to strong pricing and contributions from Lotus, the company's total revenues of $4.02 billion missed expectations, primarily due to increased unrealized mark-to-market losses on commodity derivatives. Vistra reaffirmed its 2026 financial guidance and continues to advance growth initiatives, including a significant investment in Helix Digital Infrastructure and the pending acquisition of Cogentrix Energy.

articles.headline: Vistra Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Pricing and Lotus, Revenues Miss

events.title: NiSource stock (NI): 59% of NIPSCO customers out, highlighting storm recovery costs
events.summary: Severe storms in the Midwest caused power outages for approximately 273,900 NIPSCO customers, representing 59% of its electric customer base, and 92% of Indiana's total outages. This event is prompting investors to focus on NiSource's (NYSE:NI) immediate grid performance and potential storm recovery costs, which have not yet been estimated, despite the company's previous strong EPS guidance and data center growth plans. NiSource shares were trading about 15% below their June peak, and the duration and cost of restoration efforts will significantly influence the financial impact and investor sentiment.

articles.headline: NiSource stock (NI): 59% of NIPSCO customers out, highlighting storm recovery costs

events.title: How Raymond James’ Q3 Earnings Beat and AI Push Will Impact Raymond James Financial (RJF) Investors
events.summary: Raymond James Financial (RJF) reported Q3 FY26 earnings per share of $3.14, surpassing analyst estimates due to strong performance in its investment banking, asset management, and banking sectors. This beat reinforces confidence in its diversified business model, especially as the firm heavily invests in AI, advisor recruitment, and banking growth. While these efforts aim to enhance efficiency and market position, investors should consider potential risks like market volatility and the time it might take for technology investments to yield substantial returns.

articles.headline: How Raymond James’ Q3 Earnings Beat and AI Push Will Impact Raymond James Financial (RJF) Investors

events.title: EQR: Shareholders approved all proposals enabling the merger with AvalonBay Communities, Inc
events.summary: Shareholders of Equity Residential (EQR) have approved all proposals, including the issuance of shares and a charter amendment, to facilitate its merger with AvalonBay Communities, Inc. All proposals received unanimous board support and passed. The final results will be disclosed in a Form 8-K.

articles.headline: EQR: Shareholders approved all proposals enabling the merger with AvalonBay Communities, Inc

events.title: Sysco (NYSE: SYY) details Jetro acquisition, higher leverage and $100M AI cost cuts
events.summary: Sysco (NYSE: SYY) has provided further details on its pending acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot, outlining the financial profile of the combined entity and strategies for growth and cost reduction. The company anticipates achieving $100 million in cost savings in fiscal 2027 through technology and AI initiatives, alongside targeting 6-7% sales growth and 9-11% adjusted EPS growth for the same period. Sysco also addressed the expected increase in leverage post-acquisition, projecting net debt to adjusted EBITDA to peak near 4.5x, with a plan to reduce it to a long-term target of 2.75x within 24 months.

articles.headline: Sysco (NYSE: SYY) details Jetro acquisition, higher leverage and $100M AI cost cuts

events.title: Citi's Hollenhorst Weighs Oil Against Domestic Economy
events.summary: Andrew Hollenhorst, chief US economist at Citi, discussed inflation and its potential impact on market expectations with Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn. The conversation focused on recent trends in price and labor data.

articles.headline: Citi's Hollenhorst Weighs Oil Against Domestic Economy

events.title: Astorg Completes Acquisition of Thermo Fisher Microbiology Business
events.summary: Astorg has finalized its acquisition of Thermo Fisher Scientific's global microbiology business, which will now operate as an independent entity under the leadership of newly appointed CEO Dirk Bontridder. The new company, serving over 15,000 customers in 100+ countries, aims to accelerate innovation and strengthen its global position in microbiological diagnostics for clinical, food safety, and pharmaceutical applications. Astorg plans to support the company's growth with strategic guidance and capital, with a new corporate brand launching later in 2026.

articles.headline: Astorg Completes Acquisition of Thermo Fisher Microbiology Business

events.title: LIQT: Record pool and marine growth offset by energy project delays; guidance cut to $20–$23M
events.summary: LiqTech International (LIQT) reported record commercial pool revenue and marine growth in Q2 2026, but overall revenue decreased by 12% year-over-year due to delays in water for energy projects. As a result, the company revised its full-year guidance to $20–$23 million, while noting a strengthened balance sheet and a strategic focus on markets with repeatable demand. This information is based on the Q2 2026 audio transcript.

articles.headline: LIQT: Record pool and marine growth offset by energy project delays; guidance cut to $20–$23M

events.title: Astorg Completes Acquisition of Microbiology Business From Thermo Fisher Scientific, Establishing an Independent Global Diagnostics Specialist
events.summary: Astorg has successfully acquired the global microbiology business from Thermo Fisher Scientific, establishing it as an independent global diagnostics company. The new entity, which will operate under CEO Dirk Bontridder, serves over 15,000 customers in more than 100 countries with its diagnostic consumables and equipment for clinical, food safety, and pharmaceutical applications. Astorg aims to leverage its healthcare expertise to accelerate innovation and strengthen the company's global position.

articles.headline: Astorg Completes Acquisition of Microbiology Business From Thermo Fisher Scientific, Establishing an Independent Global Diagnostics Specialist

events.title: Understanding implications for vertical mergers from the FTCs recent review of IonQ and SkyWater
events.summary: The FTC closed its investigation into IonQ's $1.8 billion acquisition of SkyWater, allowing the vertical merger to proceed despite differing views from the two Commissioners. Their statements highlight the importance of case-specific evidence, willingness to consider efficiencies and behavioral remedies, and potential consideration of broader administration policy in evaluating vertical mergers. This outcome suggests that the FTC may expedite some significant vertical merger reviews and be open to arguments about procompetitive benefits.

articles.headline: Understanding implications for vertical mergers from the FTCs recent review of IonQ and SkyWater

events.title: Principal Survey: Only 1.4% Blame AI for Staffing Cuts
events.summary: A new Principal Financial Well-Being Index℠ survey reveals that 69% of employers report employees are delaying retirement due to financial uncertainty, primarily rising cost of living and inflation. While employer sentiment about the economy is improving, only a small fraction (1.4%) of businesses attribute staffing decreases to AI or automation, with most expecting AI to increase staffing and wages or keep staffing stable.

articles.headline: Principal Survey: Only 1.4% Blame AI for Staffing Cuts

events.title: KLA, Snowflake, Airbnb And A Health Care Stock On CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
events.summary: On CNBC's "Halftime Report Final Trades," experts shared their top stock picks. Joshua Brown recommended Snowflake, Rob Sechan chose KLA Corporation, Brian Belski suggested Gilead Sciences, and Joseph M. Terranova picked Airbnb. Each recommendation was supported by recent financial performance or analyst ratings.

events.title: Wedge Capital Management L L P NC Acquires 134,228 Shares of Fidelity National Financial, Inc. $FNF
events.summary: Wedge Capital Management L L P NC increased its stake in Fidelity National Financial (FNF) by 23.2%, acquiring an additional 134,228 shares, bringing its total holdings to 711,994 shares valued at $33.6 million. Institutional investors now own 81.17% of FNF. The company also announced a quarterly dividend of $0.52 per share, reflecting a 4.4% yield, and reported Q2 earnings of $1.39 per share on $4.05 billion in revenue, exceeding analyst expectations.

articles.headline: Wedge Capital Management L L P NC Acquires 134,228 Shares of Fidelity National Financial, Inc. $FNF
